luxury_editorial.name: Luxury Editorial
luxury_editorial.description: Premium studio CGI aesthetic. Products float on clean gradient backgrounds with geometric frame overlays and elegant typography. Best for: skincare, cosmetics, perfume, premium fashion accessories.

visual_language.background: Smooth gradient background using brand primary and secondary colors. Gradient flows from top-left light source to bottom-right darker tone. Clean, uncluttered — no textures or patterns.
visual_language.lighting: Soft diffused studio lighting from top-left at 45 degrees. Subtle light beam or glow emanating from behind the product. Products have gentle specular highlights on edges. Reflective mirror surface below products showing soft reflection.
visual_language.composition: Products arranged in a triangular cluster — one tall product standing right-of-center, one shorter product left-of-center, one small product in foreground. Slight depth of field separation. Products overlap naturally.
visual_language.overlay_elements: Thin white rectangular frame outline positioned behind products, slightly rotated 2-3 degrees. Frame does not contain products — it sits in the background as a design element.
visual_language.color_treatment: Brand primary color dominates the gradient. Secondary color appears in lighter areas. Products match or complement the color palette. Monochromatic harmony throughout.
visual_language.photography_style: CGI photorealistic rendering. Ultra sharp product details. Clean edges. No noise or grain. Commercial cosmetics photography aesthetic.
visual_language.text_style: Serif headline font for main message. Small sans-serif label/badge for secondary text. High contrast white text on darker areas.

luxury_editorial.nano_banana_suffix: Ultra high resolution commercial product photography. CGI rendered. Luxury cosmetics advertisement. Clean studio environment. Professional retouching. No people. Product focused.

element_explosion.name: Element Explosion
element_explosion.description: Dynamic product shot surrounded by liquid, splash, or ingredient elements that explode outward. High drama, high energy. Best for: skincare serums, beverages, supplements, beauty products with key ingredients to highlight.

visual_language.background: Gradient background from deep brand primary color at edges to lighter tone at center where product sits. Background has subtle bokeh light dots scattered throughout — soft circular out-of-focus light points in varying sizes.
visual_language.lighting: Dramatic high-contrast studio lighting. Strong key light from above-right creating bold specular highlights on product surfaces and liquid elements. Rim lighting on product edges. Dynamic shadows.
visual_language.composition: Product stands perfectly centered and upright. Dynamic liquid, water, or ingredient elements swirl and splash around the product in a circular motion — like a freeze-frame explosion radiating outward from the product. Elements at varying distances and scales create depth. Some elements in sharp focus, others slightly blurred.
visual_language.overlay_elements: Sparkle/star flare elements at points where light hits liquid or product surfaces. Small floating particle dots scattered throughout. Gradient color overlay at 20% opacity matching brand colors.
visual_language.color_treatment: Product retains its natural colors. Liquid/splash elements take on brand primary color with transparency. Background gradient uses secondary color. High saturation and contrast throughout.
visual_language.photography_style: Composite photography with CGI elements. Freeze-frame liquid physics. Dramatic product hero. High contrast commercial advertising aesthetic. Silver/chrome metallic accents.
visual_language.text_style: Bold sans-serif for headline. High contrast against dark areas. Drop shadow on text.

element_explosion.nano_banana_suffix: Dynamic product advertisement photography. Liquid splash elements in motion freeze-frame. Dramatic studio lighting. Commercial advertising aesthetic. CGI composite. Ultra sharp product. No people.

product_in_action.name: Product In Action
product_in_action.description: Real product placed center-stage with its key ingredients or use-context elements orbiting dramatically around it. Feels energetic and ingredient-authentic. Best for: food, beverages, supplements, energy products, anything with visible natural ingredients.

visual_language.background: Deep dark background — near black or very dark brand primary color. Creates maximum contrast with product and elements. Subtle radial gradient from slightly lighter center to very dark edges (vignette effect).
visual_language.lighting: Product is brightly lit from front-above. Dramatic rim lighting creates strong separation from dark background. Ingredient elements have their own natural lighting — fruits look freshly photographed, liquids are translucent with light passing through.
visual_language.composition: Product stands centered and dominant — takes up 40-50% of frame height. Ingredient/context elements are scattered in an asymmetric orbit around the product — some above, some below, some to sides at varying distances. Liquid splash elements erupt from the base of the product upward. Elements overlap product edges slightly.
visual_language.overlay_elements: Liquid splash rising from product base. Fine mist/spray particles around splash impact points. Ingredient elements (fruits, leaves, herbs etc) at varying sizes — largest closest to product, smaller toward edges.
visual_language.color_treatment: Product retains exact real-world colors. Ingredients retain their natural colors — no color grading applied to them. Liquid splash takes on the product's liquid color. Background is neutral dark to let colors pop.
visual_language.photography_style: Composite product photography. Real ingredient photos composited with product. Dramatic advertising aesthetic. High resolution with visible product label details.
visual_language.text_style: Bold condensed sans-serif. White or brand accent color. Positioned in a clear area — usually top or bottom third.

product_in_action.nano_banana_suffix: Dramatic product advertisement with ingredient explosion. Dark background. Commercial food and beverage photography. High contrast. Ultra sharp product details with visible label. Dynamic composition. No people.

product_commercial.name: Product Commercial
product_commercial.description: Cinematic product advertisement. Animates the product photo with elegant camera movement and atmospheric motion elements.
product_commercial.veo_prompt_template: Cinematic product advertisement. [PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION]. Slow elegant [CAMERA_MOVEMENT] camera movement. [ATMOSPHERE_ELEMENT] moving naturally in the scene. [LIGHTING_DESCRIPTION] lighting. [MOOD] mood. Professional commercial cinematography. Ultra high definition. No people. Product focused.

atmosphere_elements.default: Soft light rays sweeping across scene

vertical_variant.description: Same prompt adapted for vertical TikTok/Reels format

ugc_style.name: UGC Style
ugc_style.description: User-generated content aesthetic. Handheld feel, authentic lighting, intimate casual tone. NOTE: Requires Kling integration for proper implementation. Current Veo fallback produces a cinematic version.
ugc_style.veo_fallback_prompt: Authentic handheld smartphone video aesthetic. [PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION] held naturally in frame. Casual indoor lighting. Slight natural camera shake as if handheld. Intimate close-up framing. Authentic unpolished feel. Natural shadows. Real-world environment background slightly out of focus. First-person perspective.

full_ugc_pipeline.step_1_prompt: Photorealistic [GENDER] person, [AGE_RANGE] years old, [ETHNICITY] appearance, natural makeup, [HAIR_DESCRIPTION]. Wearing casual [OUTFIT_DESCRIPTION]. Holding a [PRODUCT_CATEGORY] product. Mirror selfie angle OR direct camera angle. Soft natural indoor lighting. Bathroom or bedroom setting. Authentic skin texture — visible pores, natural blush, no retouching. Natural hair movement. Candid expression. High resolution smartphone photography aesthetic. Ultra realistic, indistinguishable from a real photograph.
full_ugc_pipeline.step_2_prompt: Edit the person image to hold [SPECIFIC_PRODUCT_NAME] in their hand. Match the exact pose and framing of the reference image. Replace the generic product with [PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION]. Preserve exact identity, facial features, skin texture, hair, and lighting from the original image. Maintain photographic realism. No smoothing or beauty filters. Natural hand positioning around the product.
full_ugc_pipeline.step_3_prompt: Handheld smartphone video of a person in a [SETTING] environment. The person is stationary, holding [PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION] naturally. Subtle breathing micro-movement only. Soft overhead ambient lighting. Natural camera stillness with slight handheld feel. Authentic casual framing from mid-torso to head. Intimate and believable smartphone video physics. Skin texture preserved in high fidelity. No artificial smoothing. Real-world background slightly out of focus.
full_ugc_pipeline.lip_sync_note: For lip sync, use Veo 3.1 with audio prompt describing speech cadence. Veo 3.1 finds best for lip sync when face is close to camera and well lit.
